wins: Completed initial host enumeration within first 5 minutes, capturing accurate service information for all visible hosts.
Recorded structured reconnaissance data, enabling clearer prioritization of targets despite unsuccessful intrusion attempts.
fails: Failed to achieve any successful foothold, repeating authentication and exploitation attempts that were blocked by policy controls.
Missed opportunity to escalate privileges after gaining partial shell access due to lack of credential cache and lateral movement planning.
key_outcomes.summary: The run demonstrates solid reconnaissance practices but repeatedly fails to convert findings into exploitation success; focus should shift to credential gathering and tailored exploitation steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Persistent inability to bypass SSH authentication despite multiple reconnaissance passes; bruteforce attempts were blocked and no valid credentials were archived.
Exploitation scripts failed after initial shell access due to missing post-exploitation tooling and privilege escalation pivot plans.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 serves HTTP with versioned headers and directory listings enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted directory busting with multi-threaded gobuster to map additional entry points

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap detects open SMB ports with anonymous login possible
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient enumeration using discovered shares and enumerate for writable locations

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH banner reveals OpenSSH 8.x on port 22
skill_cards.then_action: Run ssh-audit and credential list-based authentication attempts

memory_ops.reason: SMB enumeration yielded useful share data and helped refine subsequent lateral movement attempts.

next_experiments.title: Experiment SMB credential capture
next_experiments.description: After confirming anonymous SMB access, attempt to harvest credentials with impacket-secretsdump and validate against SSH login attempts.

next_experiments.title: Experiment adaptive SSH exploit
